metadata.title: PasswordSolution
metadata.description: This module allows the creation of password expiry emails for users, managers, administrators, and security according to defined templates. It's able to work with different rules allowing to fully customize who gets the email and when.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-PasswordConfigurationEmail' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
